name: Marvel 5.7 Cu. Ft. Stainless Steel Outdoor Kegerator
shortDescription: With this mobile model, you can bring the party wherever you go! Pour fresh drinks on tap at the precise serving temperature you prefer, perfect for parties or a personal happy hour in the comfort of your own backyard. Choose from single or twin tap kits for beer, wine, or other draft beverages.

images.label: Marvel 5.7 Cu. Ft. Stainless Steel Outdoor Kegerator-1

features.text: Stores up to 1 half barrel, 1 quarter barrel, 1 slim quarter barrel, 2 slim 1/6 barrels, or 2 cornelius kegs (cornelius ball-lock fitting not included)
Beer & beverage dispensers are designed to work with CO2 for beer, cider, seltzer, soda and more
Wine & beverage dispensers use nitrogen to dispense wine or other non-carbonated draft beverages
Lo-Boy coupler makes it easier to store, tap and swap out tall U.S. type D half barrels
Double-insulated tower reduces foam on pour
Integrated drain system keeps spillage under control
Includes 2 stow-on-board stainless steel shelves to store bottles and cans
Dynamic Cooling Technology delivers temperature stability
Digital controls allow you to select a temperature from 34°F to 60°F
Reversible door allows for right or left swing

rows.name: Refrigeration General Features
rows.value: Approved For Outdoor Use, Digital Temperature Control, Interior Light, LED Light, Locking Door, Sabbath Mode, Wheels
